defs.def: strange or unusual 奇怪的；怪异的；反常的

ex.t: 共同面对困难治愈一切

ex.s: So it may seem odd to some people knowledge of China may be limited that he is such an important figure.
ex.t: 所以对某些人来说可能看起来很奇怪，他们对中国的了解可能有限，不知道他是如此重要的人物。

defs.def: strange or unusual in the way mentioned 构成复合词

ex.s: Circle the odd one out in each group.
ex.t: 圈出每组中不同类的一项。

ex.s: To the public, he was seen as a slightly odd-looking but kind and funny man.
ex.t: 在公众眼中，他被看作一个长相略显古怪但善良风趣的人。

ex.s: This odd combination of characteristics had made him one of the greatest thinkers of the 20th and 21st centuries.
ex.t: 这种奇特的特征组合使他成为20和21世纪最伟大的思想家之一。

defs.def: happening or appearing occasionally; not very regular or frequent 无比较级或最高级
of no particular type or size; various 无比较级或最高级
not with the pair or set that it belongs to; not matching 无比较级或最高级

ex.s: When we visited the ward the next morning, we were amazed to see that against all odds, both boys were still alive.
ex.t: 当我们第二天早上去病房时，我们惊讶地发现，尽管困难重重，两个男孩都还活着。

defs.def: that cannot be divided exactly by the number two 无比较级或最高级
available; that sb can use 可得到的；可用的
